reviews.text: This is undoubtedly the best veterinary clinic in the entire neighborhood. Words cannot express our gratitude for the humanity and gentleness with which they treated us, especially Sandra. Losing Canela leaves a huge void, but knowing that Sandra was by her side and ours every step of the way is incredibly comforting. Although her treatment at the clinic was short, Sandra fought for her with all her heart until her very last breath, giving us such warm, empathetic, and respectful care that we will never forget. Thank you, Sandra, for taking care of Canela with so much love and for giving us peace during the most difficult time of our lives. ❤️
Friendly and professional staff. Every time we've taken Mini in, they've analyzed the problem and quickly identified the appropriate treatment. Thank you, Benedetta, and the rest of the team!
Excellent

I want to share our experience because I think it might be helpful for other bird owners.
I took my female cockatiel to this clinic in the Pilar neighborhood because she had been behaving completely abnormally for several days: she was much more withdrawn, had lost her appetite, and looked thinner. I emphasized that she wasn't eating as usual and that I was very worried about her. During the examination, they weighed her and found she weighed 90 grams when her usual weight was 100 grams. She was also very tired and kept closing her eyes. The vet told me that to put my mind at ease, she was going to take an X-ray. After examining her, she told me I had nothing to worry about and that my cockatiel was fine.

We went home, but my cockatiel still wasn't eating. We managed to get her to eat a little millet, but she immediately threw it up, so we made another appointment with the vet for the next morning. But when we got up and went to check on her, we found her dead.

I know it's impossible to say in hindsight what caused her death or if it could have been prevented, but I can say that as her owner, I was left with the feeling that signs that were very worrying to me, especially the weight loss, lack of appetite, and marked fatigue, weren't given the attention I expected from a veterinarian specializing in birds.

I'm writing this review because I think it's important for those who take their birds to this clinic to know about our experience, and above all, because I hope that in future cases of birds with weight loss, loss of appetite, and lethargy, these signs will be evaluated with all the attention they deserve. Unfortunately, our experience has caused us to lose confidence in this clinic, and we will be looking for another veterinarian specializing in birds for our other cockatiel.
Every summer I leave my bunny at the clinic for care, and I couldn't be happier. The service is exceptional. You can see the love they have for the animals. Highly recommended.

I've been taking my bunny, Dora the Explorer, there for over four years.
They've always treated her with great care and professionalism, especially Bene and Pilar, and the other assistants are very kind too. Whenever she's been sick, they've been able to diagnose her quickly, and even though we have a tough time during the visits, we know she's in good hands.

I never write reviews, but the work of this team, and especially Carlos, is wonderful. My 13-year-old bearded dragon arrived in very bad shape, so bad that we were expecting the worst... Although the future with a senior animal is always uncertain, whatever happens, the facts speak for themselves: they have done a spectacular job (diagnosis, surgery, follow-up...). The whole team has been incredibly dedicated to him! Their professionalism and humanity are undeniable.

Raquel, Bene, thank you, thank you, and thank you for your love for "the little gentleman."

Team, we are so grateful for giving Edgar this opportunity.

We've been taking our bunny to the Madagascar clinic ever since we brought him home eight years ago. He was a happy, much-loved bunny, and we felt (and still feel) he was one of the family. At Madagascar, they cared for him meticulously, gently, professionally, and lovingly all these years. It was always reassuring to know they were there to look after him.

Sadly, Churchill passed away two months ago, and although we are very sad and miss him dearly, now that our hearts are a little calmer, we couldn't let this opportunity pass without expressing our deepest gratitude to the entire Madagascar team for these years of care and the professionalism with which they treated our beloved pet.
Carlos, thank you for everything!

I am delighted with this clinic. From the very first moment, Bennedetta was very attentive to my chameleon, Pascal. Unfortunately, he couldn't overcome a growth that appeared on his throat, but I must say they were incredibly attentive throughout his treatment. Sadly, nothing could be done about the growth, and in the end, his quality of life was greatly diminished. The doctor recommended that the best thing was to end his suffering. Both during the treatment and on the day we had to say goodbye, they treated us wonderfully. I continue to take my dog ​​there, and I am truly delighted.

It's a great clinic for rabbits and exotic animals. Carlos and Benedetta have always been our clients, and they are true professionals. We have their annual health plan. If I had to suggest one thing for improvement, it would be that they no longer offer emergency services, which was a real peace of mind.

They're saving my hen's life, and I'm so happy and grateful to them.

Despite a few minor disagreements, they've been incredibly patient with me (supporting me and helping me with whatever I need) and have treated my hen exceptionally well.
It seems to me they have excellent specialists who can treat mammals, birds, or reptiles with the same professionalism, based on what I've seen with their other clients.

If I could write from where I am now, I would do it wagging my tail, even though you can't see me anymore.

I never liked coming to this center… it made me very nervous because I knew you were going to do something to me. But I also knew something else: if my mommy brought me here, it was because I needed it. And that always gave me a little peace.

Here, I was always welcomed and cared for with love and patience. Mommy always said good things about you, and now I understand why.

Thank you to the whole team for taking care of me for so many years, and thanks especially to Aunt Sandra, who did everything she could to make me immortal. It wasn't possible, but she tried with all her heart.

With love,
Fairy 🌈

Not recommended!! I took my guinea pig to be spayed and she died. I took her because it was recommended to me since she had an inflamed uterus, and that's why we decided to spay her. When I went to pick her up, what I found very strange at the time was the vet's attitude. While I was in the waiting room and walking past him, he wouldn't even look at me, even though he was the one who had operated on her. Now I understand why; he knew something was wrong but didn't tell me anything, not even the guidelines I should follow after the spaying. I complained to the other vet, but now I understand his attitude. After the spaying, she became very ill; a lump filled with bloody fluid appeared as a result of the procedure. She received veterinary care at another clinic, but unfortunately, she didn't make it. Before any consultation or surgery, ask about the prices. They told me one price to spay her, and after the surgery they wanted to charge me double. And it's the first veterinary clinic that's told me they'll charge me for the post-operative check-up... I have other pets that I've taken to other vets to be spayed, and they never charge me for the post-operative check-up. It's unbelievable that some vets lack dedication to their profession. It's a shame my guinea pig passed away.
Responding to your reply, nothing I'm saying is a lie. I told them how Mae was when she arrived and that spaying was recommended. They had already done blood work and an ultrasound; her uterus was inflamed, which is why we didn't repeat the tests. I didn't refuse to pay the price they quoted me initially, knowing her condition and everything they had to remove, which they did. The surprise was that they wanted to charge me double the agreed-upon price. I didn't think that was fair, and I told them so. In the end, they charged me the correct amount.
She always had veterinary care and up-to-date checkups at another veterinary clinic. Don't imply otherwise. I also called the Madagascar clinic to inform them that Mae was sick and at the emergency vet and needed her veterinary report, which took them three hours to send, even though they knew I needed it immediately.

It's not about money, because I've spent whatever it takes on my guinea pig, but I didn't go back to their clinic for those reasons: because we didn't trust the way the vet acted and because they tried to take advantage of us with the price, knowing what she was coming with.
Excellent clinic and impeccable service. Benedetta was absolutely lovely and gave our Morris exceptional care; I imagine the rest of the team is just as wonderful. Highly recommended.
Thank you so much for your feedback, Antonio; it helps us a lot. Best regards from the entire clinic team.
I always take my cats to this clinic and I'm very happy with it. They are very professional, and Carlos and Sandra, who always attend to us, are also very friendly. 100% recommended!

Excellent veterinary clinic. Carlos is a true professional who knows the pathologies of any exotic animal better than anyone. He provides outstanding service. I wholeheartedly recommend him to anyone who asks me for a veterinarian specializing in exotic animals.
The best clinic in Madrid. I don't mind traveling; it's worth it for the professionalism and the service.
They provide excellent customer service and always explain things clearly and simply. They not only know a lot about animals, but you always feel like you're in the best hands.

I will always be grateful to Dr. Pilar, this veterinary clinic, and everyone who works here. My kitten is very, very nervous, but from day one, they treated her incredibly well and were so kind. My cat had a procedure done on a bad tooth, and now she's fine. Before, going to the vet was a nightmare, but now, even though Chibi doesn't like going, she behaves much better because of their positive attitude and the wonderful treatment she receives. Thank you so much for everything, and we will definitely continue going for checkups, tests, and everything else.

I would choose this clinic a million times over. You have been there for 5 years, caring for and attending to Atenea, and although she is no longer with us, I want to thank Sandra, Bene, Carlos, Pilar who treated her less but was equally important, and the assistant Raquel, a great professional, for your dedication, great professionalism and unparalleled humanity. On behalf of Atenea and her family, thank you from the bottom of our hearts.

I took my rabbit there and they spayed her to prevent future illnesses. It went wonderfully, the service was excellent, and they were very efficient.
I'm very happy with them. Good price.
They are a very well-prepared team professionally and, in addition, they are people with great empathy, especially Carlos.

The entire team treated us exceptionally well. In a very difficult situation, they made the whole process as easy as possible for us. I will always say it's a top-notch clinic, with a truly dedicated and exceptional staff. And I want to take this opportunity to give a huge thank you to Pilar; from the moment Lana arrived, she treated her with so much care.

Excellent service! I want to express my deepest gratitude for the care my guinea pig, Cervantes, received. From the very first moment, their dedication, patience, and affection were evident. I felt at ease knowing he was in the hands of professionals who truly love animals. Thank you.

Unfortunately, this clinic is no longer decent. They don't even know how to trim a cat's claw, and they just dump you on the surgeon. I don't think they're veterinarians; they're probably just trying to rip you off with consultations that don't produce results—€40 for a visit! I suppose they're clueless and completely unprofessional, or maybe the staff has left, leaving no one with experience. We'll never go back. We were there years ago, but the last two times it was anything but veterinary; it was more like, "I see you as a wallet to be taken from."

They botched the injection on my rabbit, and I had to have him euthanized. I was going to file a complaint about the mistreatment I received over the phone, but I decided against it. The clinic owner, yelling at me because I went to speak to the woman who injected my rabbit, threw me out of the clinic, shouting aggressively and saying unbelievable things. He was completely out of control; I had to call the police. He has no manners. He's basing his actions on the fact that years ago I said I was going to file a complaint because they treated me badly over the phone, which I never did. He needs to learn some manners; he seems like a madman. I absolutely do not recommend this clinic unless you want to have your pets killed. I used to take my poodle there, and the rabbit they killed.
Our guinea pig has been treated very well.
Thank you from the bottom of my heart to Pilar and Raquel... You have been wonderful!!! .... My deepest admiration for you both 🕊️ …
We took our very sick dwarf rabbit with diarrhea and he couldn't have received better care. Very professional and lovely, thank you so much, guys. Maria

Excellent professionals, very friendly service.

I highly recommend them.

One of the worst places ever! €65 for a check-up on two kittens, and they did absolutely nothing. When I got home, one of them had five ticks and ear mites. Now they want to charge me another €40 to check their feces, even though they forgot to weigh them during the first visit. It's a complete disaster. You can tell when they're just after money and don't care about animals. They're shameless. IF YOU LOVE YOUR ANIMALS, I ABSOLUTELY DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS PLACE.

I've been taking my rabbit to this clinic for years, and the treatment we receive is always outstanding.
She's had to undergo several surgeries for common rabbit problems, and the pampering, affection, attention, and care they always give Rosita is wonderful.
Two years ago, she had two surgeries, and throughout the entire process, they took care of her down to the smallest detail. The treatment and empathy I received from them made me feel right at home.
Bene, Sandra, Pilar, Carlos… and other professionals who have treated her over the years have always done so in a professional yet caring manner.
Whenever I have to take my little one, I feel at ease because they'll make sure to do all the necessary tests, checkups, and give her the treatment she needs to be healthy.
You know that for us, our little ones are family, so thank you for the care and love you put into your work and especially into them ♥️

The best veterinary clinic.

I have nothing but words of gratitude for everyone who works here: kind, friendly, caring, and attentive. Especially Sandra, who has made very difficult times with my cats much less traumatic and stressful, always with sincerity, transparency, and a personal touch.

Not a single negative word.
Excellent service, it was my first time there but I'll be back. Thank you
Thank you so much for the review, Saskia, and for the time you spent writing it; it's truly helpful. Best regards.
They always treat both our bunny and us wonderfully.

We've been patients at the clinic for over seven years. The treatment is the best I've ever received. The information is always clear and complete.
Every time we approach with Zeus, he starts pulling from the corner to get there, because Sandra treats him with so much love.
Thank you so much, Madagascar!!!
